title_zh: 区分相似手工杯并选定礼物包装

scenario.label_zh: 区分相似手工杯并选定礼物包装
scenario.goal_zh: 比较两只外形相似但图案不同的杯子，选定蓝色条纹款并约定用礼盒包装且不在杯身贴胶带

context_zh: 顾客在手工艺店挑选礼物。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Orla
sentences.text: These two mugs look alike from here. Are they printed from the same design?

sentences.speaker: Mateo
sentences.text: No. The shapes match, but each painted pattern is unique. This one has a blue stripe; that one has little blue dots.

sentences.speaker: Orla
sentences.text: I'll take the stripe. My brother prefers simple patterns.

sentences.speaker: Mateo
sentences.text: Would you like me to wrap it?

sentences.speaker: Orla
sentences.text: Yes, but could you avoid sticking tape to the mug? He likes to keep the maker's label.

sentences.speaker: Mateo
sentences.text: Certainly. I'll put it in this gift box with paper around it and no tape on the mug.

sentences.speaker: Orla
sentences.text: That will be perfect. The striped one in that box, please.
